      📖 Complete User Manual & Operational Guide

      Follow this step-by-step workflow to set up your examination center, generate zero-vacancy seating plans, manage seniority-aware duty rosters, and print calibrated A4/A5 reports.

      Step 1: Master Data & Bilingual Setup

      • Go to 📁 Master Data and enter your Institution Name in both English and Bangla.
      • Add your Buildings with both English (e.g., Science Building) and Bangla (e.g., বিজ্ঞান ভবন) names.
      • Upload or add Regular Teachers (with BCS Batch for automatic seniority sorting), Guest Teachers, and Staff/MLSS. Click 👁️ View Current on any card to inspect or print that category.
      • Create Rooms in Rooms Configuration, set mandatory Teachers/MLSS per room, and click any seat cell in the Room Builder to block broken benches (turns red).

      Step 2: Exam Profile, Routine & Students

      • Open 📝 Exam Profiles, create your exam (in English & Bangla), and save your Default Building & Room Fill Serials.
      • Upload your Routine Excel or add dates manually with start time and duration (powers the live countdown on the Dashboard).
      • Go to 👥 Students and upload the examinee Excel file. Use the Record Expelled Student card to log any expelled roll (automatically removes them from seating plans).

      Step 3: Combinatorial, AI & Manual Seating Plan

      • In 🪑 Seating Plan, select 🧠 Smart Combinatorial Optimizer or click 🧠 Smart 100% Combinatorial Fill. The engine tests multi-subject combinations so occupied rooms have 0% vacancy, minimal subjects per room, and zero same-subject neighbors.
      • Click 🔄 New Version to create alternative seating versions (`v1`, `v2`...) and switch between them.
      • Manual Edits & Full Manual Builder: Click any seat cell in the preview to edit/swap rolls, or use the Full Manual Seat Plan Builder to pick a Room + Subject and auto-paste rolls. All edits save permanently!

      Step 4: Auto, Interactive & Manual Duty Roster

      • In 🛡️ Duty Roster, click 🚀 Generate & Save Duty Roster. Every room automatically gets a Regular Senior Teacher at #1 and Regular MLSS at #1.
      • Interactive Cell Edit: Click any teacher/MLSS badge in the generated roster to open the Picker (toggle between Only Pre-Assigned or All Active). Already-used teachers are marked red.
      • Separate Manual Roster: Use Section 3 to build a roster manually from scratch and click Check Seniority & Save.
      • Click 📋 Copy Assigned Names to view and copy Regular, Guest, Peon, or All names to your clipboard.

      Step 5: Interactive Print & Table Studio (Persistent Document Setup)

      • Open 🖨️ Print Center and click any report card. Inside the Interactive Print & Table Studio, click any table cell to widen/narrow its column, change font size, align text, adjust row height/padding, or merge cells.
      • Click 💾 Save Table Setup for This Document in the studio toolbar — your custom column widths and table attributes are saved permanently for that specific report and survive page refresh and restart!
